description_expanded:
This condominium in the newly completed Dannelly building on the 2nd floor brings you right to the heart of Alys Beach and the Town Center. Upon entry, you will find a large space including the kitchen, living room, dining areas and access to a covered balcony. The primary suite offers a king-sized bed with private bath containing a walk-in shower. The guest bedroom offers a queen-sized bed with private bath containing a tub/shower combo. Both bedrooms provide access to a shared covered balcony. Parking for this unit is an assigned space behind the building. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.

Alys Beach is expanding its development surrounding Dannelly 201. The photography above may not reflect the current views as impacted by construction. For a construction map, please click the link below.
